description: This file defines the DisabledTransactionAgent class implementing the ITransactionAgent interface. It provides stub implementations that throw exceptions indicating transactions are disabled.

classes.name: DisabledTransactionAgent
classes.description: A class implementing ITransactionAgent with disabled transaction behavior.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Throws OrleansTransactionsDisabledException to indicate transactions are disabled.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Throws OrleansTransactionsDisabledException when resolving transaction status.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Throws OrleansStartTransactionFailedException indicating starting a transaction failed due to transactions being disabled.
